5 تطيّب [quasi-pass. of 2, as such signifying It became, or was made or rendered, good,
pleasant, &c.: and] he perfumed himself, or made himself fragrant, (A, Msb, TA,) بِالطِّيبِ [with perfume], (Msb,) or بِالشِّىْءِ [with the thing]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
